description: He wears a long burgundy-red sleeveless outer tunic or surcoat-style layer with broad gold heraldic and floral woven borders at the collar, front edges and hem. A cream textured long shirt shows at the front opening and full sleeves, with decorated cuffs. A dark brown belt has a round ornate gold-toned buckle and a decorated hanging leather end. Dark brown narrow trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. All garments are opaque and well tailored, with noble craftsmanship but no ceremonial regalia. The hands rest behind the torso in this relaxed standing pose. No headgear, armor or weapons appear; textile fibers cannot be confirmed visually.
